description: Alterations to the existing ground floor rear extension including changes to the door opening and roof line with additional roof windows.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Flood Risk Assessment, Design & Access Statement: Received 14/02/2019. 1143 - 01 - 09, 1143 - 01 - 03, 1143 - 01 - 02, 1143 - 01 - 05, 1143 - 01 - 01, 1143 - 01 - 04, 1143 - 01 - 06, 1143 - 01 - 07, 1132 - 01 - 00, 1143 - 01 - 08, 1132 - 02 - 08, 1132 - 02 - 09, 1132 - 02 - 02, 1132 - 02 - 01, 1132 - 02 - 05, 1132 - 02 - 04, 1132 - 02 - 03, 1132 - 02 - 10, 1132 - 02 - 06, 1132 - 02 - 07: Received 13/03/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
